make_descriptor_from_proto: build a protobuf Descriptor from a DescriptorProto message using MakeDescriptor with a package name
create_field_descriptor: create a FieldDescriptor for a proto field with type, label, number, and default value
convert_proto_type_to_cpp: convert a Python proto type to its corresponding C++ type using ProtoTypeToCppProtoType
create_enum_descriptor: create an EnumDescriptor with named values and numbers for a protobuf enum type
get_descriptor_options: retrieve or create default options for a descriptor using the GetOptions method
